details: Bitcoin has seen a significant rally, breaking above $80,000 for the first time in nearly 15 weeks and marking a 25% surge over the past seven days. This robust performance is primarily driven by strong institutional demand, with US spot Bitcoin ETFs recording approximately $1.9 billion in net inflows last week—the strongest weekly total in 10 months. Furthermore, positive commentary from President Trump on Bitcoin accumulation and the broader digital asset industry, coupled with ongoing progress on supportive digital asset regulations like the CLARITY Act, has fueled bullish sentiment. Ethereum has also outperformed Bitcoin, contributing to a wider risk-on movement across the crypto market.
title: Bitcoin Surges Past $80,000 Amid Strong ETF Inflows and Regulatory Optimism

details: The US Treasury has expanded its long-duration bond buyback program, increasing operations to at least $4 billion to enhance market liquidity. This move has contributed to a weaker US dollar and is generally seen as favorable for risk assets, including cryptocurrencies. Investors are now keenly focused on key US economic releases scheduled for this week, including the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) inflation index (the Federal Reserve's preferred inflation gauge), revised Q2 GDP growth, and jobs data. Additionally, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's inaugural keynote address at the Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium on Friday will be closely scrutinized for signals on the Federal Reserve's monetary policy trajectory, which could significantly impact interest rate expectations and overall market sentiment.
title: US Treasury Boosts Liquidity; Critical Macro Data & Jackson Hole Meeting Ahead

details: There's a noticeable increase in positive regulatory momentum for digital assets in the United States. President Trump has reiterated his call for Congress to pass the CLARITY Act, a legislative effort aimed at providing clear regulatory frameworks for cryptocurrencies, with prediction markets showing a recovery in expectations for its 2026 passage. This push for clearer regulation, alongside ongoing efforts by the SEC and CFTC to develop more supportive guidelines for digital assets, is viewed favorably by the crypto industry. Such developments are anticipated to strengthen the outlook for crypto-related businesses and foster a more predictable operating environment.
title: Growing Political Support for Crypto Clarity in the US
